data.narrative:
Valar Atomics is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Isaiah P. Taylor, currently valued at $6.0B post-money. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 11 nuclear energy peers: 3 public companies (Oklo, Nano Nuclear Energy, X-Energy) and 8 private firms including Helion, Fuse Energy, and others in the same sector and valuation tier.

Two methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x applied to the $6.0B last post-money valuation, implies $11.4B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector comparables—Helion at $15.5B (Series G), Oklo at $7.0B (public), and X-Energy at $5.6B (public)—yields a median of $7.0B, with a range spanning $5.6B to $15.5B.

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $6.0B (low) to $13.1B (high), with a median of $9.2B. This implies modest upside from the current $6.0B valuation. Key uncertainties include timing and assumptions embedded in the stage-progression step-up multiplier, the limited peer set, and heterogeneity across the comp universe given the wide spread from Oklo to Helion. The current valuation appears defensible relative to same-sector peers, though sensitivity to capital deployment milestones remains material.
